_comment: Proposal for detailed maps of France: thirteen metropolitan regions, one map each, ARA first. See docs/REGIONS-FR.md. No code reads this file.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:FR-style codes, including FR-20R for Corsica, pending ISO verification.
codes.why: Country-prefixed identifiers keep French regions separate from US state map identifiers.
codes.verified: not checked: ISO OBP needed JavaScript; browser unavailable

etalab-2.0.name: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence version 2.0
etalab-2.0.attribution: Name the source (at least the licensor) and the date of the reused information’s last update; do not imply endorsement.

ODbL-1.0.name: Open Database License 1.0
ODbL-1.0.attribution: Credit OpenStreetMap contributors for OSM; credit data.gouv.fr and its stated sources for the contours. Keep ODbL notices and offer a publicly used derivative database under ODbL.

terrain.format: ASCII grid in 7z (25 m D063 feed read)
terrain.split: By département for the checked 25 m delivery
terrain.size_ara: 504,640,761 bytes (twelve 25 m ASCII archives; administrative ARA only)
terrain.notes: Proposed first terrain input because 25 m is close to the existing US 1 arc-second input. All twelve département edition feeds read; total excludes checksum sidecars and neighbouring areas needed for the margin.

terrain.format: ASCII grid; 1 m TIFF also listed for D063; 7z archives
terrain.split: By département; combine and clip locally
terrain.size_ara: 5,530,775,007 bytes (twelve 5 m ASCII archives; administrative ARA only)
terrain.notes: Bare-earth terrain. Catalogue says source updating stopped in 2024 pending a new elevation reference. All twelve département edition feeds read; selected editions range from 2020 to 2023. Total excludes checksum sidecars and neighbouring areas needed for the margin.

water.format: ZIP Shapefile; individual layers also GeoPackage and GeoJSON
water.split: Metropolitan bulk files; no région or département archive confirmed
water.notes: Sandre announcement and publisher catalogue resources read. Includes watercourses, water bodies and catchments. Listed download URLs were read from metadata; bulk archives were not downloaded.

dams.dataset: Ouvrages faisant obstacle à l’écoulement (ROE / OBS)
dams.format: WFS export: GeoPackage or zipped Shapefile
dams.split: National export; no pre-cut région or département archive confirmed
dams.notes: Publisher metadata lists active and frozen exports separately. A barrier register is not a dam safety or storage-capacity inventory. An old obs_FXX service URL returned 404; the current catalogue points to geo/obs.

crops.format: GeoPackage in 7z for R84, RPG delivery version 4.0
crops.split: France and région files; département archive not confirmed
crops.notes: IGN feed and Ministry announcement read. Edition in feed: 2025-01-01; publication in 2026. Covers declared agricultural parcels, not a complete land-cover raster. Crop-code mapping was not checked.

buildings.dataset: BD TOPO 3.5, buildings and named places
buildings.format: GeoPackage or Shapefile; 7z archive checked for R84
buildings.split: Région and département deliveries; national alternatives in catalogue
buildings.notes: Catalogue explicitly includes building heights and named places. Archive is all themes, not buildings alone. Height completeness and meaning of each height field were not checked.

places.dataset: BD TOPO 3.5, buildings and named places
places.format: GeoPackage or Shapefile; 7z archive checked for R84
places.split: Région and département deliveries; national alternatives in catalogue
places.notes: Catalogue explicitly includes building heights and named places. Archive is all themes, not buildings alone. Height completeness and meaning of each height field were not checked.

places.split: National tables with REG and DEP fields; filter locally
places.size_ara: Not shown; national commune CSV advertised as 3 Mo
places.notes: Code/name and parent-area tables, not coordinate points. INSEE terms explicitly name Licence Ouverte 2.0. Join to boundary or BAN geometry.

places.format: CSV; alternative CSV with commune centroids
places.split: National table; filter through commune codes locally
places.size_ara: Not shown; raw national CSV metadata 1,555,485 bytes
places.notes: Own page and publisher data.gouv.fr metadata opened. Maps postcodes to communes; postcode boundaries are explicitly not supplied as open data. The portal’s 460 Mo display is not the raw CSV size.

places.format: OSM PBF; regional GeoPackage links also listed
places.split: Older régions, not the present thirteen; no département split listed
places.size_ara: Auvergne 149 MB + Rhône-Alpes 508 MB (rounded page labels)
places.notes: Two older-region extracts would need merging and deduplication, then cutting to the proposed box. Their combined extent was not compared with the padded box. National PBF is an alternative; parent page says 4.8 GB.

addresses.format: CSV.gz; Addok and BAL alternatives in catalogue
addresses.split: National and département CSVs; no région CSV in checked directory
addresses.size_ara: About 108.49 MB, sum of twelve rounded directory labels
addresses.notes: Department labels read on 2026-11-17: 01 9.13 MB; 03 6.81; 07 6.95; 15 3.46; 26 8.87; 38 15.54; 42 9.71; 43 5.43; 63 12.38; 69 12.58; 73 6.90; 74 10.73. Not an exact byte total or an installed-index estimate.

pois.split: National daily file; filter locally; pre-cut area files not listed
pois.size_ara: No ARA file; national daily archive 51,897,398 bytes
pois.notes: Publisher metadata read via data.gouv.fr API after HTML fetch timed out. Includes closed structures: retain active geographic establishments, not legal entities. Current coordinate schema and emergency-service categories not checked.

pois.split: National public exports; filter locally; area archives not listed
pois.size_ara: No ARA file; national CSV 80,714,753 bytes; JSON 220,392,433 bytes
pois.notes: Only public operator-declared data is exported. Field-level access hours, status and completeness were not inspected.

postal_code.format: Five digits, stored as text to retain leading zeros.

addressing.order: Number and optional suffix, street type and name, then five-digit postcode and locality.
addressing.notes: normalize() deletes accented letters; punctuation becomes spaces; bis remains a word. _parts() recognises a five-digit postcode only at the end and puts a separated bis among street words. No engine code was changed.
